name: mixer
title: Mixer
description: A mixing desk that splits a total between channels: moving one fader moves the unlocked others in proportion, so the channels always sum to the total, and a locked channel stays put. Each fader is UI SDK's vertical slider with an LED meter, each lock a UI SDK toggle, with setChannel, setAll and lock for agents.

docs: `<Mixer label channels value|defaultValue onValueChange onValueCommit locked|defaultLocked onLockedChange total step format locale disabled labels>`. `channels` is `{ id, label }[]`; the value is each channel's share by id and sums to `total` (100 by default), split evenly at first. Every fader is a slider named by its channel: arrows move `step`, Page Up and Down ten steps. A drag keeps the others' shares from when it began, so a fader pushed to the top and back gives them back. Locked channels are read-only; an agent's `setChannel` past what they leave, `setAll` that doesn't sum to the total or moves a locked channel, and any move with every other channel locked fail the step with why. The desk is dark metal in every theme (the item's `css`).
